data.source.workspace.note: source = how the workspace was found (a code: argv, env, pointer).

detail.forced_stop.text: Last stop was forced: the lap in progress may be lost

text.one: {n} write refused by Pitwall: see the outbox folder
text.other: {n} writes refused by Pitwall: see the outbox folder

exit.tip.text: Stop every running service and quit the iRacing connector

logs.footer.text: {file} · hover a line for the full text, or open the file

notice.forced.message.text: It did not stop within {seconds} s; the lap in progress may be lost.
notice.forced.message.note: seconds = the stop timeout, a number.

notice.shm_error.message.text: Not recording. See the Logs screen.

options.autostart.text: Start the iRacing connector with Windows

options.autostart.note.text: Opens in the tray at logon and starts the services set to start with the app. Off by default.

options.error.autostart_change.text: Cannot change the Windows autostart entry: {error}

options.error.autostart_read.text: Cannot read the Windows autostart entry: {error}

options.hz.note.text: Applies the next time the recorder starts. Default 60 Hz.

options.minimized.note.text: Closing the window (X) always hides the app to the tray. Exit (bottom left, or the tray menu) stops every service and quits.

options.start.note.text: Laps are recorded only while the recorder runs. Switching it on the Services page changes this too.

options.start.recorder.note.text: On by default: laps are recorded only while it runs.

services.managed.text: Managed by Stintmate: it starts and stops it for you.

shortcut.needs_stintmate.text.text: The iRacing connector runs under Stintmate, which starts it and keeps it running. Stintmate is not installed on this PC, so the connector was not started. Open stintmate.app to get Stintmate?
shortcut.needs_stintmate.text.note: A Yes/No question under the title "iRacing connector". Yes opens the Stintmate website, No closes it.

startup.error.detail.note: code and message = the workspace error.

startup.error.hint.text: No service was started and nothing was written. Fix the folder, then start the iRacing connector again.

startup.error.title.text: The iRacing connector cannot start: its data folder is not usable.

status.not_installed.text: Cannot start: the connector is not installed correctly · run `uv sync`

status.ownership.external.text: Running (external, not tied to the app)

status.recorder.driving_offline.text: Recording · Pitwall not running: the laps wait for it

status.recorder.garage_offline.text: In the garage · Pitwall not running: the laps will wait for it

status.recorder.lap.note: Part of the Recorder's state line. lap = the current lap number.

status.recorder.off_game_running.text: Off · iRacing is running: laps are not recorded

status.recorder.session.note: Part of the Recorder's state line. session = Pitwall's session id.

status.recorder.stint.note: Part of the Recorder's state line. stint = the stint number.

status.tooltip_line.note: One line of the tray tooltip: a service's name and its state.

tray.service.start.note: Tray menu item: start a service.

tray.service.stop.note: Tray menu item: stop a service.
